$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
# #997 MIGRATION — MIG-11d. Bounded attempt to restore the container stack the acceptance-test
# reboot took down.
#
# The cause is established and is not this migration: Docker Desktop's engine is launched from
# HKCU:\...\Run, which only fires at interactive logon. There was no logon after this boot --
# no explorer, no type-2/10/11 logon events -- so both WSL distros stayed Stopped. Tailscale, which
# this lane never touched, is in the same state for the same reason.
#
# Still: this lane asked for the reboot, so it owes an attempt to put the stack back. The attempt is
# deliberately small and reversible -- start the engine's WSL distro, then Docker Desktop itself --
# and it is allowed to fail. What is NOT acceptable is improvising a permanent autostart change to
# the owner's Docker configuration to make a report look tidy; that is a change to the stack this
# packet said to leave alone, and it belongs to the owner as a typed recommendation.

Write-Output '--- BEFORE ---'
& wsl.exe --list --verbose 2>&1
docker ps 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 3

Write-Output '--- ATTEMPT-1: start the engine WSL distro ---'
$job = Start-Job { & wsl.exe -d docker-desktop -e /bin/sh -c 'echo distro_up' 2>&1 }
$done = Wait-Job $job -Timeout 90
if ($done) { Receive-Job $job } else { Write-Output 'wsl docker-desktop start TIMED OUT after 90s'; Stop-Job $job }
Remove-Job $job -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
& wsl.exe --list --verbose 2>&1
Write-Output '--- docker after attempt 1 ---'
docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Status}}' 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 5

Write-Output '--- ATTEMPT-2: launch Docker Desktop ---'
$exe = 'C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe'
Write-Output "exe_present=$(Test-Path $exe)"
if (Test-Path $exe) {
    Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Write-Output 'launched (session 0; a GUI app here may or may not bring the engine up)'
}
for ($i = 0; $i -lt 24; $i++) {
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 10
    $out = docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' 2>&1
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Output "docker API answered after $((($i + 1) * 10))s"; break }
}
Write-Output '--- AFTER ---'
& wsl.exe --list --verbose 2>&1
docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Status}}|{{.Ports}}' 2>&1
Write-Output "docker_rc=$LASTEXITCODE"
Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match 'docker|vpnkit' } | Select-Object Id, ProcessName | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 60

Write-Output '--- OLLAMA-SERVICE-UNCHANGED-THROUGHOUT ---'
Write-Output "task=$((Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'WilliamOS-HERMES-Ollama').State)"
try { Write-Output "api_models=$((Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags' -TimeoutSec 10).models.Count)" } catch { Write-Output "api_ERR=$($_.Exception.Message)" }
& 'C:\Windows\System32\nvidia-smi.exe' --query-gpu=uuid,power.limit,memory.used --format=csv,noheader
Write-Output '--- RC ---'
